# iOS Apps by Ashwin Anbazhagan

> Independent iOS apps by Ashwin Anbazhagan, made to help people reflect, connect, and keep the moments they love.

## Apps
- [Honestly — Journal & Reflect](https://hosting-pages.netlify.app/honestly): Write before you scroll. Journal with guided prompts, explore 1,400+ affirmations, and see your selected topics across reading, customizable widgets and daily reminders. Premium app blocking helps protect time for your morning pages.
- [tether — Long Distance Letters](https://hosting-pages.netlify.app/tether): Write a note in a handwriting pen, fold it into a paper plane and throw it; it flies across the real map to the person you miss and unfolds in their city. tether+ offers monthly, yearly and lifetime purchase options. Letters are kept end-to-end encrypted in your own iCloud.
- [Snipsy — Photo Stamps & Stickers](https://hosting-pages.netlify.app/snipsy): Turns any photo into a collectible postage stamp or die-cut sticker using on-device Vision. 10 hand-crafted paper variants, iMessage stickers, fully offline.

## Guides & Comparisons
- Each app has in-depth guide and comparison pages at /{app}/guide/{slug} and /{app}/compare/{slug}, covering specific use cases, conditions, and competitor comparisons.
